note: Gaps the build must know: (1) brainOutbox.flush holds the outbox lock across its control call, so if the brain's own flush waits for a replacement, the killed fact's write blocks behind it and the SIGKILL comes at the call's bound, not at the grace; the throwaway code let the brain's own flush fail offline at once while a replacement is pending. (2) Real workerd takes SIGTERM as its drain and exits with no signal, so L11 and L7's honoring case expect signal null, not SIGTERM as the plan says. (3) The crash-path half of reachable makes calls after an exit wait and a braked brain unable to send its spans, so dev-control's call law and the exit law read the spans a second start on the same home delivers. (4) local-instance.integration.test.ts needs no change: its startDev is the app's. (5) The ps stand-in lives inside memory-replace.laws.integration.test.ts, not rss.test-support.ts: lint:dead flags a test-support export only tests call, and the unreachable list takes no new rows. (6) L4 is a type law, red only under pnpm typecheck, which this step did not run. (7) The L8 plant that only skips the stopping state stayed green, because the stopped state still clears the replacement; the plant that skips both went red.
